clips.text_zh: 又嚟。Saudi 東西管道被炸，Hormuz 出唔到，全球 10% 油產受影響。Repairs 要 6 至 12 個月。今日 oil 反跌，wtf。Prop firm 又輸多一注 😭🙏
clips.text_en_b1: Big happening: oil could hit $150 soon. The Saudi east-west pipeline got hit. Now Saudi oil cannot go around the Strait of Hormuz. This is the only pipeline from the Persian Gulf to the Red Sea. Satellite pictures show fires at multiple spots, and one pump station may be hit. AI repair estimate: 6 to 12 months.
clips.source_hint: /biz/ OP claims Saudi east-west pipeline hit, AI repair estimate 6-12 months

signal.rationale: Oil supply shock plus Saudi pipeline damage historically supports gold as a safe haven

clips.text_en_b2: Looks like another round of chaos. The Saudi east-west pipeline has been struck, which effectively blocks crude from bypassing the Strait of Hormuz, the only land route from the Persian Gulf to the Red Sea. Satellite imagery confirms fires at multiple locations and possibly one pump station. AI-driven damage assessments estimate repairs will take anywhere from six to twelve months, even though Saudi Arabia controls roughly ten percent of global oil production. Ironically, prices dumped today, which makes absolutely no sense whatsoever.
clips.text_en_c1: A genuinely seismic development appears to be unfolding in the energy markets. Should the Saudi east–west pipeline remain compromised, Brent crude could feasibly surge toward the $150 mark within weeks, given that the conduit bypasses the Strait of Hormuz entirely — the sole artery linking the Persian Gulf to the Red Sea. Satellite imagery confirms fires at several points, and at least one pump station seems to have sustained damage, with AI-assisted assessments pegging repairs at six to twelve months. Saudi Arabia accounts for roughly ten percent of global output. Paradoxically, oil actually dumped in today's session, which frankly defies any rational explanation.
clips.text_en_c2: A strike on Saudi Arabia's east-west pipeline has once again thrust the chokepoint question into sharp relief, with satellite imagery confirming fires at multiple sites and what appears to be damage to at least one pump station. Crucially, this is the sole conduit by which Saudi crude can bypass the Strait of Hormuz, the narrowing through which a significant fraction of seaborne exports must otherwise pass. Given that the kingdom accounts for roughly ten percent of global supply, an AI-derived repair window of six to twelve months would, by any conventional logic, suggest a sustained premium. That oil futures instead dumped on the session is, frankly, perverse, although one suspects the algos had already priced the geopolitical risk into contango long before the headlines cleared. Prop book, predictably, bled further.

clips.text_zh: DOGE 三日內上太空。你唔買？爆咗都會郁啦，點解唔入少少先。萬一又係 SNL 2.0 就走佬。Prop firm 入咗細注 🧐👍
clips.text_en_b1: Doge goes to fucking space in 3 days and you are not buying. If this shit explodes it will still move up, so why not ape a bit, then sell so it does not become SNL 2.0? Or maybe it will just start the hype again. Either way the next few days will be wild for DOGE holders.
clips.source_hint: /biz/ OP hyping DOGE pump within 3 days, wants to ape small and sell before SNL-style dump

signal.rationale: Anon's plan is a quick scalp long on DOGE hype, exit before the SNL-style dump

clips.text_en_b2: DOGE is about to blast off within three days, and you are still sitting on the fence. Even if it blows up, there will still be volatility, so why not throw a small position in and bail before it turns into another SNL-style disaster? Or maybe it kicks off a fresh wave of hype. Either way, the coming days are shaping up to be absolutely wild for anyone holding DOGE.
clips.text_en_c1: DOGE is, by any reasonable measure, primed to go absolutely stratospheric within the next seventy-two hours, yet retail conviction remains conspicuously absent. If the catalyst merely catches a modest bid rather than detonating outright, the position will still appreciate, provided one rotates out before it inevitably devolves into SNL 2.0. Conversely, should momentum reaccelerate, the ensuing hype cycle could prove disproportionately lucrative. In either scenario, the forthcoming sessions are destined to be exceptionally volatile for holders, and anyone sidelined ought to weigh whether continued passivity is itself a form of exposure. A speculative allocation seems warranted.
clips.text_en_c2: Dogecoin is, by any rational metric, a meme dressed in the thinnest veneer of utility, yet its trajectory over the next seventy-two hours promises to be genuinely theatrical. The calculus is not whether the underlying asset possesses intrinsic merit; it is whether the reflexive loop of attention and liquidity can sustain another leg up before the gravity of an SNL-style capitulation reasserts itself. Aping a measured position, with the discipline to de-risk if sentiment flips, remains the asymmetric play, since even an eventual blow-off top ought to beget violent two-directional movement. In the meantime, expect retail euphoria to metastasise across social platforms, with derivatives open interest ballooning accordingly. Prop desk, naturally, has already taken a starter position.

clips.text_zh: 22 歲 dogecoin 贏錢，買咗 230K condo，drop out 兩年。之後返學 grad，現在 100K 一年，27 歲，信用卡債，廢柴 cycle。佢都係食緊學費，我地都係 😭
clips.text_en_b1: Stuck with a Condo. In 2021 when I was 22 I made a bunch of random crypto money from Dogecoin. Lived for two years with no job, perma vacation, dropped out of school and bought a condo for $230K. Eventually money ran out. Went back to school, graduated, and now make $100K and live in my condo.
clips.source_hint: /biz/ OP got out of the rat race by 22 with crypto condo, now trapped at 27 with debt
clips.text_en_b2: I am completely stuck with a condo I cannot offload. Back in 2021, when I was twenty-two, I made a ridiculous amount on Dogecoin and blew it on a two-year vacation with no job. I dropped out, bought a 230K condo, and eventually ran out of cash. I went back, graduated, and now I earn around 100K a year at twenty-seven. Student debt, credit card debt, and a relentless work-consume-repeat cycle.
clips.text_en_c1: At twenty-two, I accumulated a substantial sum through speculative positions in Dogecoin during the 2021 mania. Flush with windfall profits, I abandoned university, settled into an indefinite perma-vacation lifestyle, and purchased a condominium valued at two hundred and thirty thousand dollars. Within roughly two years the capital evaporated, forcing a reluctant return to academia. Upon graduating I secured employment offering a hundred thousand annually, which, while respectable, hardly compensates for the accumulated student loans and revolving credit-card balances. Now twenty-seven, I inhabit a Sisyphean cycle of labour and consumption, perpetually servicing debt rather than accruing wealth. The condo, once emblematic of liberation, has become an albatross.
clips.text_en_c2: At twenty-two, flush with apparently inexhaustible Dogecoin gains, I succumbed to the seductive narrative that markets would continue to reward audacity indefinitely. For two years I pursued what can only be described as a perma-vacation, forfeiting my education and committing two hundred and thirty thousand dollars to a condominium purchase that now sits as a monument to that particular delusion. Once the liquidity evaporated, reality asserted itself with characteristic indifference: I returned to university, graduated, and now earn a respectable hundred thousand annually while servicing both student and credit card obligations from within those same walls. At twenty-seven, trapped in what feels like an inescapable cycle of labour, consumption, repetition, I find myself a cautionary parable, awaiting the next cohort to learn precisely the same lesson.

clips.text_zh: 佢哋自己都認 AI model plateau 咗，跟住吹自律故事呃 VC。talmudic bullshit 又嚟。AI 嚟搶我地白領同藍領，呢個真 😩🙏
clips.text_en_b1: So they are admitting AI models have plateaued and now they are coming up with some fake story about self restraint so they do not lose VC money. I am so tired of this talmudic bullshit. The model progress has clearly stalled and the industry is just making up excuses for the slowdown.
clips.source_hint: /g/ poster claims AI labs admit models plateaued, blame cope narratives

signal.rationale: Sentiment post on AI hype, no specific trade

clips.text_en_b2: So the labs are finally admitting that model progress has plateaued, and now they are spinning some half-baked narrative about self-restraint just to keep the VC money flowing. I am absolutely sick of this talmudic nonsense dressed up as research. Meanwhile, these same models are coming for both white-collar and blue-collar jobs, and that part, at least, is genuinely terrifying.
clips.text_en_c1: It is increasingly evident that leading laboratories have effectively conceded that frontier model progress has plateaued, and rather than confronting this reality with intellectual honesty, they have pivoted toward manufacturing elaborate narratives about hypothetical self-restraint — a transparent stratagem designed to pacify venture capital allocators alarmed by diminishing returns on compute expenditure. The rationalisation is transparently sophistic, verging on the talmudic in its hair-splitting contortions. Meanwhile, the substantive capabilities that once inspired genuine trepidation among white-collar professionals have demonstrably stalled. The displacement that practitioners across both cognitive and manual occupational strata have long anticipated may simply arrive later than projected, though the underlying trajectory remains, regrettably, intact.
clips.text_en_c2: It is increasingly difficult to ignore the conspicuous admission, cloaked though it is in the usual corporate circumlocution, that frontier model development has encountered a demonstrable plateau. Having oversold capabilities to venture capital with such conviction, the laboratories now find themselves compelled to manufacture a narrative of deliberate restraint, as though compute constraints were a principled choice rather than an inconvenient engineering reality. The talmudic gymnastics required to reconcile prior pronouncements with present performance would, under any less credulous audience, provoke outright derision. Meanwhile, the displacement rhetoric continues apace, since nothing quite soothes jittery capital allocators as the assurance that whatever white-collar function you perform, an ostensibly imminent iteration will render it redundant. The cognitive dissonance is, at this juncture, almost admirable in its scope.

clips.text_zh: Trump + Elon + DOGE 已經 cut entitlement，係 state machine 太勁 cut 唔到。Elon libertarian 想砍 trillion 都冇 political will。算啦 🙏
clips.text_en_b1: I will still support Trump if anything to piss off leftist freaks. I am cynical when it comes to serious policy change and reversing the American decline. I think Trump and DOGE did their best to cut the entitlement spending monster, but the political machinery and state apparatus were too powerful and they had to back off.
clips.source_hint: /pol/ Trump supporter defends DOGE cuts, blames deep state for blocking deeper cuts

signal.rationale: Political opinion post, not a market call

clips.text_en_b2: I will keep backing Trump if only to wind up the leftist brigade, although I am deeply cynical about meaningful policy reform. Trump and DOGE made a genuine push to slash entitlement spending, but the political machinery and entrenched state apparatus were simply too powerful to overcome. Musk, being a libertarian at heart, would have loved to gut trillions from social security and Medicaid, yet the political will to follow through was never there.
clips.text_en_c1: Notwithstanding their earnest efforts, the Trump–Musk DOGE initiative encountered the entrenched apparatus of the administrative state and ultimately retreated. Entitlement programmes — that sprawling constellation of social security, medicare, and medicaid — proved politically untouchable, however much Musk, whose libertarian instincts would gladly have excised trillions from federal outlays, might have wished otherwise. The machinery of incumbency, with its entrenched constituencies and procedural inertia, simply outmuscled whatever reformist mandate the executive branch could marshal. One is left to conclude that meaningful fiscal rectification remains a function of political will which, at present, is conspicuously absent from Washington. The American decline, accordingly, proceeds largely unimpeded.
clips.text_en_c2: Cynicism, I confess, has become my default posture regarding the possibility of substantive reform within the American political economy, though I remain broadly supportive of the Trump administration if only for the visceral pleasure it affords the commentariat. The genuinely interesting question concerns the limits of executive willpower when confronted with the deeply entrenched administrative apparatus, which appears to have rebuffed even the combined efforts of Musk's Department of Government Efficiency. Entitlements, the sacred cow of which no serious fiscal consolidation can ultimately spare, remain structurally untouched. One suspects that the libertarian fantasy of excising trillions from Medicaid and Social Security will continue to function primarily as a thought experiment, rather than a legislative programme, irrespective of which faction nominally holds the reins.

clips.text_zh: 佢同佢 twin 食一樣 calories、protein、carbs、fat，連屎燒埋都一樣。點解佢肥佢瘦？靠 AI 續命都解唔到 😩🧐
clips.text_en_b1: I have an identical twin brother. He is lean. I am fat. We measured how much we eat and the calorie measurement is identical. The dietary fat, protein, and carbs are all identical. We also collected our faeces and incinerated it, and it also had an identical calorie measurement. What is causing me to be obese while my brother is lean?
clips.source_hint: /fit/ OP and twin eat identical calories, even burnt poop matches, yet weight differs
clips.text_en_b2: My identical twin brother is lean, whereas I am clinically obese. We meticulously tracked everything: identical calorie intake, identical macros across fat, protein, and carbs, and identical physical activity. To rule out absorption issues, we even collected and incinerated our faeces, and the residual calorie measurements matched perfectly. So what on earth is driving this stubborn weight gap? I have thrown every AI tool at the problem and still come up empty.
clips.text_en_c1: My identical twin brother and I have undertaken a rigorous comparative analysis of our respective metabolisms, controlling every conceivable dietary variable. Caloric intake is matched within measurement error, as are macronutrient distributions — protein, carbohydrates, and lipids are essentially identical between us. In a further attempt to account for differential absorption, we even subjected our collected faecal matter to bomb calorimetry, only to discover that excreted caloric content was likewise indistinguishable. Yet despite this meticulous parity, he remains conspicuously lean whereas I exhibit clinically obese adiposity. The discrepancy persists regardless of intervention, and no algorithmic analysis has yielded a remotely satisfactory explanation for this stubborn asymmetry.
clips.text_en_c2: My identical twin brother and I present, as far as I can determine, an empirical puzzle of considerable metabolic intrigue, since we share ostensibly identical genomes yet diverge phenotypically to a stark degree. Over the past several months we have scrupulously documented our respective caloric intakes, finding the totals indistinguishable; macronutrient partitioning, comprising fats, proteins, and carbohydrates, likewise correlates with negligible deviation. In a flourish of admittedly unhinged methodological commitment, we even collected and incinerated our faecal matter, only to discover that caloric output through that channel was likewise congruent between us. Despite every variable I have been able to isolate yielding identical values, he remains conspicuously lean whilst I continue to gain adipose tissue, and no amount of artificial intelligence consultation has elucidated the underlying mechanism.

clips.text_zh: 睇完 Ghost in the Shell 動畫，頭幾集麻麻地，跟住越嚟越正。Season 2 幾時出？等緊 🧐🙏
clips.text_en_b1: Just finished the Ghost in the Shell anime and it was great. The first couple of episodes I was not so sure, but it got better and better with each episode. The stand-alone complex story really opens up around episode four. Season 2 when? Anyone know if there is a proper follow-up coming?
clips.source_hint: /a/ anon finished Ghost in the Shell anime, asks when Season 2 drops

signal.rationale: Anime viewing thread, no market signal

clips.text_en_b2: Finally wrapped up the Ghost in the Shell anime and I have to say it really grew on me. The opening episodes felt a bit flat, although once the Stand Alone Complex arc kicks in around episode four, the worldbuilding and plotlines really take off. The writing tightens up considerably as it goes, and the philosophical undertones become far more compelling. Does anyone know whether a proper second season is actually in development?
clips.text_en_c1: Having finally completed the Ghost in the Shell anime, I can confidently pronounce it exceptional, notwithstanding a rather tentative opening that initially failed to hook me. The inaugural episodes felt somewhat diffuse, yet the narrative progressively coalesces around the fourth instalment, whereupon the Stand Alone Complex arc truly matures into something genuinely compelling. Subsequent episodes build upon this foundation with admirable consistency, weaving philosophical inquiry into kinetic action with rare finesse. What remains maddeningly opaque, however, is any firm confirmation regarding a second season. Speculation abounds across fan forums, though substantive announcements appear perpetually deferred, leaving devotees in a state of suspended anticipation.
clips.text_en_c2: Having finally completed the Ghost in the Shell television series, I find myself persuaded that its reputation as a landmark of the medium is, if anything, understated, though the opening episodes admittedly demand a degree of patient acclimation before the narrative architecture reveals itself. The initial instalments feel almost tentative, as though Production I.G were calibrating tone, yet by the fourth episode the Stand Alone Complex conceit begins to cohere into something genuinely compelling, with the interweaving of discrete cases producing thematic resonances that far exceed the sum of their parts. Each subsequent instalment accrues additional weight, such that by the conclusion one is left with that peculiar sense of bereavement peculiar to finite art. As for the perpetually mooted second season, definitive news remains conspicuously absent.
